free_tier.stated: Shared and rate-limited: 16 concurrent requests and 20M tokens per day per address, counted across prompt and completion and reset at 00:00 UTC.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: an OpenAI-compatible key plus the vendor's own clients
chaining: The key is a real keyless read path for model inference, but it is shared and IP-counted; the demo page also runs with no key at all.

limits.value: 20M tokens per day per address; 16 concurrent requests on the shared trial key

identity_cost.detail: a shared public trial key is published in the docs; no signup or card to use it

reliability_note: the trial key is public and shared, so prompts are not private; a 429 with Retry-After appears at the concurrency limit

evidence.proved: a public shared trial key serves 20M tokens per day per address with no card
